checks.name: i7-real-transport-failure
checks.summary: Ledger sequence 10. Induced by setting ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1 as a one-off ExtraEnv override (not part of environment.base_names; no other invocation in this task uses ExtraEnv) for this single invocation only. Empirically measured before wiring this test: an unreachable base URL causes the real CLI to hang (no output at all after 90s in an out-of-band manual probe), rather than failing fast, so the induction uses a real 25s context.WithTimeout; the deadline firing is context.DeadlineExceeded, which SupervisedInvocationRunner.Run deliberately does NOT treat as a cancel-and-skip case (that is reserved for an explicit user cancel, I8, or a real external signal, I5) -- it falls through to classification. Result: Succeeded=false, Failure.Class=provider.FailureTransport (exit_code-based classification through provider.ClaudeAdapter.Parse, exactly as any other adapter-classified failure), Execution ended domain.ExecutionFailed, no retry converted it to green, and total_cost_usd settled at 0 (the request never reached the API, exercising transport failure specifically -- never model failure or quota failure, whose per-Provider coverage remains M6's V2-028).

checks.name: i8-real-cancel

The child's actual absence was confirmed by polling pid liveness with a bounded 10s deadline, never a fixed sleep.
